meta.title: About us
meta.description: Amanah Partners is a team that manages the whole international education journey for students in Uzbekistan and their families.

header.title: Your child's future is entrusted to us.
header.lede: Amanah Partners is a team that manages the whole international education journey for students in Uzbekistan and their families, from start to finish.

blocks.title: Who are we?
paragraphs: We handle lessons, exams, university applications and visas with one team. At every stage parents know who to talk to.

Amanah Partners works together with Faydalan Academy, which runs the same model in Türkiye. Lessons, mentoring by professors, our partnership with a Pearson-approved exam centre and our international application network are shared. Students in Uzbekistan have a dedicated team that speaks Uzbek and Russian.

blocks.title: Every student is a project of their own
paragraphs: We plan the student's personality, academic goals, skills and international career together.

blocks.title: Our team
blocks.intro: Our team has worked with nearly 50 universities and advised hundreds of students. It includes advisers with over 10 years of experience and professors who mentor our students.
